title: Cisco Nexus 3000 Series NX-OS Release Notes, Release 10.1(2)
notices: Upgrading Cisco Nexus 3500 and Cisco Nexus 3600 Series Switches

observations.description: MTC-XL : Not able to boot MTC-XL using PXE, bootmode and boot order not honoured Symptoms: N3K-C3548P-10G, N3K-C3548P-10GX and N3K-C3548P-XL do not support PXE boot Workarounds: N/A

IMR6_23:mac-address is getting flagged in incompatibility chk even after removing it from SVI on XL. Symptoms: mac-address config is getting flagged in incompatibility check even after removing it from SVI on N3K-C3548P-XL. Workarounds: N/A

IMR6_64: Incompatible config mac-address even after removing it from SVI which is not mapped on XL Symptoms: Incompatible config static router mac-address(CAP_FEATURE_SVI_MAC_ADDR_MTC) is getting flagged even after removing it from SVI which is not mapped to any interface. Just have a dummy SVI with static RMAC and then remove static RMAC and check incompatibility. It is getting flagged even after removing the static RMAC config. Workarounds: N/A

MTC-XL JPLUS : "no lacp port-number front-panel" unsupported cli added by feature lacp, CR fails Symptoms: Enable feature lacp on MTC-XL box also configures "no lacp port-number front-panel" under running-config, which seems like a unsupported command hence it is breaking configure replace operations. Workarounds: N/A
